name: ada-spark
description: Teach coding agents to write idiomatic, correct, current Ada and SPARK

interface.shortDescription: Write idiomatic, current Ada and SPARK
interface.longDescription: Helps agents write, port, review, and prove Ada and SPARK. Embeds an always-on correction map to prevent stale pre-2022 assumptions (GNAT Community is gone -> Alire; aspects not pragmas; Pre'Class for dispatching; CodePeer is now GNAT SAS; SPARK has move/observe/borrow pointers; Ada 2022 is finalized), with guidance for contracts, the Alire ecosystem, SPARK proof (AoRTE, assurance levels), embedded (Ravenscar/Jorvik), and tooling (GNAT, GNATprove, GNAT SAS).
defaultPrompt: Write an Ada package with contracts
Prove this subprogram free of runtime errors with SPARK
Set up an Alire project for a Cortex-M target
